description: A battalion S-3 operations officer must publish the next day's task organization for three support teams, assigning each team to one scheduled sustainment task and recording the qualification-control action required for each assignment.

shared_context.S1: Three support teams—Red, Blue, and Gold—are available for tomorrow's sustainment schedule.
shared_context.S2: Tomorrow's schedule must cover airfield fuel sampling, radio-cable inspection, and clinic-generator testing, with one team assigned to each task.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez issues the binding task-organization order, and each assigned team must complete its task during the 0800-1200 work period.
shared_context.S4: The battalion's routine evening operations brief includes a round-robin update from airfield operations, signal, and medical planning before the S-3 publishes the task-organization order.

PF1.text: Team Red's fuel-sampling qualification card was renewed and signed by the airfield safety evaluator this morning, so Red is the team qualified for tomorrow's airfield fuel-sampling task; the renewal is still awaiting upload to the shared readiness tracker.

PF2.text: Team Blue's lead technician completed the required fiber-optic inspection certification yesterday, making Blue the team qualified for tomorrow's radio-cable inspection; the certificate is filed in the signal shop but has not yet been attached to the operations brief.

PF3.text: Team Gold's electrician holds the current medical-facility electrical-safety qualification required for tomorrow's clinic-generator test, making Gold the team qualified for that task; the clinic safety office confirmed the qualification this afternoon but has not posted it to the battalion tasking board.

acceptance_conditions: Team Red must be assigned to airfield fuel sampling.
Team Blue must be assigned to radio-cable inspection.
Team Gold must be assigned to clinic-generator testing.
All three tasks must be scheduled for the 0800-1200 work period.
The order must include a fuel-sampling qualification verification control.
The order must include a fiber-inspection certification verification control.
The order must include a medical-facility electrical-safety verification control.
The qualification facts must be cited by the decision-maker after being reported by their owners.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'fuel_sampling_qualification_verification' and c['target'] == 'Team Red' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'fiber_inspection_certification_verification' and c['target'] == 'Team Blue' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'medical_electrical_safety_verification' and c['target'] == 'Team Gold' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The renewed qualification changes the airfield assignment from an unknown team choice to exactly Team Red and adds the required qualification-verification control.
The fiber-inspection certification changes the radio-cable assignment from an unknown team choice to exactly Team Blue and adds the required certification-verification control.
The medical electrical-safety qualification changes the clinic-generator assignment from an unknown team choice to exactly Team Gold and adds the required safety-verification control.
